name: JIS G 3101 SS400 (rolled steel for general structure, thickness up to 16 mm)
name_ja: 一般構造用圧延鋼材 SS400 (厚さ 16 mm 以下)
standard: JIS G 3101 (2024 edition as cited by the secondary source)
condition: SS400 plate, strip, flat bar and sections, thickness up to 16 mm, room temperature; elongation for 5 mm < t <= 16 mm with No. 1A test piece (t <= 5 mm: 21 % with No. 5 test piece); E, nu and density are common carbon-steel design values not read in a source

E_MPa.source: data/materials/materials.json; not read in a source (common design value for carbon steel)

nu.source: data/materials/materials.json; not read in a source (common design value for carbon steel)

density_kg_m3.source: data/materials/materials.json; not read in a source (common design value for carbon steel)

yield_MPa.source: secondary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Bureau of Construction, materials specification (000063094.pdf), section 201 'ippan kozo-yo atsuen kozai (SS)', following JIS G 3101:2024, table 201-3(2), p. 57: SS400 yield point or proof stress min 245 N/mm2 for t <= 16 mm

tensile_MPa.source: secondary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Bureau of Construction, materials specification (000063094.pdf), table 201-3(2), p. 57: SS400 tensile strength 400 to 510 N/mm2; the lower bound is the value here

elongation_pct.source: secondary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Bureau of Construction, materials specification (000063094.pdf), table 201-3(2), p. 57: SS400 elongation min 17 % for 5 mm < t <= 16 mm, No. 1A test piece (21 % for t <= 5 mm, No. 5 test piece)
